cards.text: Friend, Jesus just took the little daughter of Jairus, a synagogue leader, by the hand and told her to get up. And she GOT UP (Mark 5:22-23, 41-42). Now Jesus moves on from there, and His disciples come along with Him.

cards.question: Jesus and His disciples are on the move again. Where does Jesus go next?

cards.text: When the Sabbath comes, Jesus starts teaching in His hometown synagogue. Friend, the questions start FLYING: "Where did this man get these ideas?" and "What is this wisdom He has been given?"

cards.question: In the synagogue, the hometown crowd keeps asking where Jesus got His ideas and His wisdom. As they hear Him teach, many of them are ___.
Along with His wisdom, the hometown crowd also asks how Jesus can perform such miracles.

cards.text: Then the questions get personal. That's the hometown move, friend: you do something AMAZING, and somebody in the back is STILL saying, hold up, I know your people.

cards.question: The hometown crowd knows exactly what Jesus did for work. They call Him the ___.

cards.text: Then they name His mother, Mary, and His brothers James, Joses, Judas and Simon, plus His sisters right there in town. Friend, that's not a question anymore, that's a ROLL CALL.

cards.question: The hometown crowd is astonished by Jesus' wisdom and miracles, but they know Him as the local carpenter. How do they end up responding to Him?

answers.text: They ask Him to stay longer
They follow Him to the next town

cards.text: Then Jesus speaks to them about how a prophet gets treated, and friend, He doesn't have to look far for an example. He's standing in one.

cards.question: Standing in His hometown, Jesus says a prophet is without honor everywhere he goes.

cards.text: Remember that little girl Jesus took by the hand, the one who GOT UP (Mark 5:41-42)? Here in His hometown, Jesus could not perform any miracles, except for one thing.

cards.question: In His hometown, Jesus could not perform any miracles except one thing. What does He do?

answers.text: He lays hands on a few sick people and heals them
He drives demons out of a man in town
He makes a lame man walk at the synagogue

cards.text: Then comes a line I don't take lightly, friend: Jesus is amazed.

cards.question: The people of His hometown took offense at Him, and Jesus is amazed at their ___.
After all that unbelief in His hometown, what does Jesus do next?

answers.text: He goes from village to village teaching
He goes up a mountain alone to pray
He sails back across the sea to rest
